title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Relief Where a Written Condition Report Is Owed
content:
## Training Q&A: relief for reports the office owes

**When is relief allowed?** Relief is allowed against the charge a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record earns on instalments left unpaid where the office owes the owner a written condition report. The reading is of the preventive visits completed on the agreement against the written condition reports issued for preventive visits on it.

**How much relief?**

| Preventive visits completed on the agreement carrying no written condition report | Relief allowed |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | the repeat lapse relief, 35.00 USD |
| exactly 1 | the single lapse relief, 15.00 USD |
| none — every completed preventive visit carries a written condition report | no relief |

**Is the relief per report?** No. The relief is the one figure the count selects: 35.00 USD where 2 or more completed preventive visits carry no written condition report, 15.00 USD where exactly 1 does, and nothing where none does.

**What if the tier includes no written condition report at all?** Then no completed preventive visit carries an outstanding report and no relief is allowed under this Q&A.

**Worked count (hypothetical).** An agreement with 5 completed preventive visits and 4 written condition reports issued for preventive visits has exactly 1 completed preventive visit carrying no report, so the single lapse relief of 15.00 USD is allowed. With 3 reports issued against 5 completed preventive visits the count is 2, so the repeat lapse relief of 35.00 USD is allowed.
